sourcesContent:
<!-- Show navbar before login -->
 <app-navbar *ngIf="!isLoggedIn"></app-navbar>
 
 <!-- Show Admin navbar after login -->
 <app-adminnav
   *ngIf="isLoggedIn && role === 'Admin'">
 </app-adminnav>
  
 <!-- Show User navbar after login -->
 <app-usernav
   *ngIf="isLoggedIn && role === 'User'">
 </app-usernav>
  
 <router-outlet></router-outlet>
